# Reveal

Content that rises 10px and fades in over 400ms. Siblings with rising index values start 90ms apart. The thank-you page’s cards arrive this way.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/reveal)

## Usage

```tsx
<Reveal index={0} active={ready}>…</Reveal>
<Reveal index={1} active={ready}>…</Reveal>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `index` | `number` | Position in the sequence. Delay is index × 90ms + 120ms. |
| `active` | `boolean` | Hidden until true. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Reveal.module.css`
- `Reveal.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
